findings.detail: all 120 scenarios cannot be exposed within 320 discovery calls under the frozen discovery cost (108 x 3 + 12 x 4 = 372); at most 106 scenarios (best case). E-ROBUST-UNSEEN condition (4) is therefore NOT_DEMONSTRATED for every model unless the budget or corpus shape changes. User decision required.
